item.create_submarine.pressure_goggles.t:
Engineer's Goggles that also show
where the water presses on the hull
of every ship nearby.
When Sneak + R-Clicked, held or worn with an empty hand

Cycles between Absolute,
Distribution and Off. Off hides
the colours and keeps the goggles.

Red means the block is at the limit
of what it can hold and will crack.
At the surface, shows the ship at
the depth where it starts cracking.

Red marks the most exposed blocks
of the ship, whatever the depth.
Shows how the load moves when
the ship tilts.
create_submarine.electrolyzer.alternator: Alternator module: insert a Shaft to run it through the Electrolyzer. Spin it and it powers the machine directly.
item.create_submarine.arresting_hook.too:
A hook that grabs a Steel Cable
stretched across the ship's path
and brings the ship to a stop.

Lowers its arm and grabs the nearest
Steel Cable within 2 blocks, then
holds the ship against it.

Raises the arm and lets go.
Only works on a ship, never on
a cable tied to its own ship.
create_submarine.ponder.arresting_hook.t: The Arresting Hook goes under a ship, like the hook of a plane landing on a carrier.
Give it a redstone signal to lower its arm.
When the arm passes within 2 blocks of a Steel Cable, it grabs it and brakes the ship until it stops.
Cut the signal to raise the arm and let go of the cable.
It only grabs Steel Cables, and never one tied to its own ship.
create_submarine.configuration.ballastFo: Multiplier on the vertical force ballast tanks apply. Lower = slower dive/ascend, higher = snappier.
create_submarine.configuration.ballastLi:
Submarine mass each ballast tank can drive up or down (roughly 1 per block).
Total lift scales with the number of tanks: a heavy submarine needs more of them.
create_submarine.configuration.ballastTr: Multiplier on the ballast vent fill/drain transfer rate. Lower = slower filling/emptying, higher = faster.
create_submarine.configuration.ballastVe: Maximum vertical speed (blocks per tick) ballast tanks drive the submarine at when diving or ascending. Higher = faster. The old fixed value was 2.0.
create_submarine.configuration.client.to: Client-side settings for UI and rendering.
create_submarine.configuration.deeperOce: How many blocks deeper to push the ocean floor when Deeper Oceans is on. WARNING: large values generate and render far more terrain and can badly hurt performance. Raise it carefully. Default 10.
create_submarine.configuration.floaterLi:
Mass each floater can push toward the surface (roughly 1 per block).
Total lift scales with the number of floaters.
create_submarine.configuration.disableIm: Disable all hull implosion damage from water pressure.
create_submarine.configuration.implosion: Depth below the surface, in blocks, past which a hull block giving way to the pressure implodes the whole submarine. Above it, the block only bursts and the room floods through the hole. Default: 120.
create_submarine.configuration.disableSt: Disable all Deep Seas startup UI screens (Welcome screen and Update notifications). Highly recommended to set this to TRUE if you are creating a modpack.
create_submarine.configuration.veilLight: Coloured moving Veil lights on the Sonar, the Industrial Alarm and the Submarine Staff. Turn it off to use plain Minecraft light everywhere instead: the blocks keep their normal Minecraft light. Always off when Iris is installed, even with shaders turned off, because Veil cannot draw them alongside Iris.
create_submarine.configuration.photosens: For photosensitive or epileptic players. The Industrial Alarm no longer throws its coloured flashing Veil light, only normal Minecraft light. Other Veil lights are not affected.
create_submarine.configuration.alarmStea: Industrial Alarms keep their lamp and light on while they sound instead of flashing. Turn this on if a photosensitive or epileptic player is on the server. Applies to every player.
create_submarine.configuration.progressi: Experimental: a breach fills the ship block by block with real water that weighs it down. When off, a breach below the waterline lets the sea into the whole room at once.
create_submarine.configuration.experimen: Replace the Abyss terrain with the tectonic seafloor (plates, trenches, ridges, three biomes). Only new Abyss chunks change, and the Abyss height range changes too, so test it on a new world.
create_submarine.configuration.enableDee: Deepen the ocean floor below vanilla. Off = vanilla ocean depth. Set the amount with Deeper Oceans Depth.
create_submarine.configuration.enableBoa: Hide the ocean surface seen inside floating boats (sub-levels without an oxygen system).
create_submarine.configuration.globalMax: Cap applied to maxWaterDepth of all non Create Deep Seas blocks. Per-block values are stored in config/submarine_hull.json.
item.create_submarine.decompression_cham:
An airlock valve. Pipe water through
its back face to flood or empty a room.
When a face opens into a sealed room

Pumping in fills the room with water
layer by layer from the floor up.
Pumping out empties it again.
When a face opens onto the sea

Gives or takes sea water without limit.
Flood the airlock before opening
its outer door deep underwater,
or the sea crushes it in.
create_submarine.configuration.ignoredUp: Internal: stores the version string of the last update notification dismissed by the user.
create_submarine.configuration.implosion: Multiplier on every block's implosion chance at runtime. Lower = slower cracking, higher = faster cracking.
create_submarine.configuration.pressureM: CLASSIC: each block holds down to its own max depth, whatever the shape of the hull. HYBRID: that depth is scaled by the shape of the hull. Wide flat walls hold less, small panels, thick walls, ribs and rounded hulls hold more.
create_submarine.configuration.shapeRefe: HYBRID only: free width, in blocks, of a single-thickness wall that keeps exactly its block's max depth. Wider panels hold less, narrower or thicker ones hold more.
create_submarine.configuration.shapeFact: HYBRID only: lowest multiplier the shape of the hull can put on a block's max depth.
HYBRID only: highest multiplier the shape of the hull can put on a block's max depth.
create_submarine.configuration.shapeMaxB: HYBRID only: ships with more solid blocks than this skip the shape analysis and use CLASSIC depths. Very large ships take more memory and time to analyse.
create_submarine.configuration.liquidDen: Density of each liquid compared to water, written fluid=density or #tag=density. A denser liquid presses harder: at the same depth, lava (3.0) cracks a hull three times sooner than water. Liquids not listed count as water.
create_submarine.configuration.lavaBurns: Flammable hull blocks (wood, wool...) touching lava catch fire.
create_submarine.configuration.maxDepthM: Multiplier on every block's effective maxWaterDepth at runtime. Lower = more fragile hulls, higher = tougher hulls.
create_submarine.configuration.oxygenMax: Maximum size, in blocks, of a creation that oxygen diffusers can scan and fill with breathable air. Raise this if air pockets stop working on very large ships. WARNING: large values use more memory and take longer to scan.
create_submarine.configuration.pulleyMax: Maximum sliding speed of a pulley along a steel cable (blocks/s). Above this speed the pulley starts overheating.
create_submarine.configuration.steelCabl: Maximum length of a steel cable in blocks (distance between its two attachment points). Very long cables can cause server lag. Default 1000.
create_submarine.configuration.title: Create Deep Seas
create_submarine.configuration.waterThru: Multiplier on water thruster thrust output. Lower = weaker propulsion, higher = stronger.
create_submarine.configuration.welcomeSc: Internal: Set to true once the Deep Seas welcome screen is confirmed. Set back to false to show the welcome screen again on the next main menu.
create_submarine.ponder.ballast_vent.hea: Letting the Sea In and Out
create_submarine.ponder.ballast_vent.tex: The Ballast Vent is the submarine's sea valve. It is how sea water gets into the ballasts, and back out.
At least one of its faces must touch the sea, or there is nothing to pump.
Pipe it to the Ballast Tanks through a pump. Every face of the vent takes a pipe, and the vent itself needs no rotation or redstone.
A pump pulling from the vent draws in sea water and fills the ballasts. The submarine gets heavier and dives.
Turn the pump around and it pushes the water back into the vent, which dumps it into the sea. The ballasts empty and the submarine rises.
With an Onboard Computer on board, Pump Controllers pick the direction and the speed on their own.
create_submarine.ponder.electrolyzer.tex: The Electrolyzer requires water to produce oxygen.
It must be powered by Forge Energy (FE).
Water is converted into Oxygen for your submarine!
You have the choice between Create Crafts & Additions, Create New Age, and Create Power Grid to provide electricity.
Put a Shaft in the module slot of its GUI: it now runs through the Electrolyzer, front to back.
Spin that shaft and the Electrolyzer turns the rotation into its own power. No electrical network needed!
create_submarine.ponder.onboard_computer: The Onboard Computer steers the dive by itself. Aim at its screen and click to set a target depth and a speed.
It watches the fill level of every Ballast Tank on the submarine.

With a Sonar on board, the Autopilot page follows the sea floor on its own: it looks a few seconds ahead along your course and dives or climbs early to stay 4 m above the bottom, so slopes and rocks never catch you by surprise. It never goes deeper than your hull can take, and while it is on the target depth is set for you.
create_submarine.ponder.decompression_ch: An airlock lets the crew leave and board a submarine underwater. It is a small sealed room with an outer door to the sea and an inner door to the ship.
Place a Decompression Chamber so one of its faces opens into the airlock. Its back face is the pipe port and must stay reachable.
Place a second Chamber so one of its faces opens onto the sea. Facing the sea, it gives and takes water without limit.
Link the two pipe ports with pipes and a Mechanical Pump.
Pumping from the sea into the airlock floods it with water, layer by layer from the floor up.
Once the airlock is full, open the outer door and swim out. The water level is the same on both sides, so nothing rushes in.
To come back aboard, close the outer door and reverse the pump: the airlock empties back into the sea.
When it is dry, open the inner door and step back inside.
Never open the outer door deep underwater while the airlock still holds air: the sea crushes it in.
create_submarine.ponder.sonar.header: Scanning the Sea Floor with the Sonar
create_submarine.ponder.sonar.text_1: The Sonar maps the water around the submarine: the sea floor, rocks, other ships and underwater mines.
create_submarine.ponder.sonar.text_2: It can stand on a floor, hang from a ceiling or be fixed to a wall. Its plates keep spinning while it listens.
create_submarine.ponder.sonar.text_3: On the same ship as an Onboard Computer, it unlocks new pages. The arrows in the bottom right corner of the screen switch between them.
create_submarine.ponder.sonar.text_4: The Sonar page draws the terrain around the ship and how much room is left under the hull. The magnifier opens a larger map you can drag, turn and zoom.
create_submarine.ponder.sonar.text_5: With a sonar on board, the Autopilot page can follow the sea floor on its own and keep the keel clear of the ground.
create_submarine.ponder.onboard_computer: Pump Controllers placed anywhere on the same submarine are found automatically. No link or wiring needed.
Pipe the Pump Controller between the Ballast Vent and the Ballast Tanks. It works out on its own which end leads to the tanks, whichever way it faces.
Give the pumps rotation and the computer takes over: it fills the ballasts to dive and drains them to rise.
It measures how fast your pumps really are and brakes just in time, then holds the target depth.
More Pump Controllers, or faster rotation, mean quicker dives.
The Oxygen Diffuser requires oxygen generated by an Electrolyzer.
It consumes oxygen proportionally to the size of the submarine.
To activate the Oxygen Diffuser, provide it with a redstone signal.
create_submarine.ponder.pulley.text_1:
Pinch the cable between
two Pulleys facing each other
to attach a sublevel to it.
create_submarine.ponder.pulley.text_2:
The sublevel will then
follow the cable wherever it goes.
create_submarine.ponder.steel_cable.head: Steel Cable
create_submarine.ponder.steel_cable.text:
Entities can walk on
a taut steel cable.
create_submarine.ponder.steel_cable_elec:
With an electricity mod such as
Create: Addition, supply FE
directly to the Rope Winch
holding the cable to electrify it.
create_submarine.ponder.barometer.text_1: The Barometer indicates the pressure applied on the submarine.
create_submarine.ponder.barometer.text_2: It compares it to the maximum pressure the hull can sustain based on its weakest block.
create_submarine.ponder.barometer.text_3: You can also name the fish inside with a Name Tag to have a companion in the abyss!
create_submarine.ponder.barometer_displa: You can attach a Display Link to the Barometer.
This allows you to broadcast the submarine's depth and hull integrity to any Display Board!
create_submarine.ponder.water_thruster.t: The Water Thruster uses pressurized water to generate thrust.
Connecting it to a water source and providing kinetic energy will activate it.
The more pressure and speed, the faster you go!
This tank provides the necessary water for the propulsion.

create_submarine.safety.title: Photosensitivity Warning
create_submarine.safety.message:
Create: Deep Seas contains flashing lights and strong screen effects. When a submarine dives too deep, the Industrial Alarm flashes bright red up to five times per second, and hull implosions shake the camera and make the lights flicker.

If you are photosensitive or have epilepsy, tick the box below: the alarm's coloured Veil light is turned off. The alarm lamp itself still blinks, unless the world or server has alarmSteadyLight turned on in the Deep Seas server config. You can change this at any time in the Deep Seas client config.

create_submarine.implosion.death.2: Every metre down added another tonne. The last one was too many.
create_submarine.implosion.death.3: The pressure found the weakest point. It always does.
